admission.justification: Treating a bounded census as complete would label unreached agents gone and hide valid document chats.

applicability: Live-agent listing completeness consumed by tree discovery.
conditions: Only hasMore false establishes completion; ten-page and missing-cursor stops do not.
exclusions: A listed live agent can remain known even when the whole census is incomplete.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_paseo_status_bridge.py › test_agents_live_lists_in_pages_and_says_when_the_listing_did_not_end, test_a_recorded_agent_a_listing_did_not_reach_is_unknown_to_the_tree_and_not_gone (the real bridge script through read_live_agents and document_chat_tree); red before the repair: notes/reports/worker/c41a5d77-92e0-4b18-a3d6-140c0a7e0b50/after-evidence-attempt3/red/red-F04.txt

statement: The listing of the host's agents counts as complete only when the host said that it ended; an agent that a listing did not reach is unknown, not gone.
